title: Bobby Vinton – I Love How You Love Me (Epic) 4-Track Stereo Tape Cartridge
descriptionText:
Up for sale is a vintage 4-track stereo tape cartridge featuring Bobby Vinton’s I Love How You Love Me on Epic Records. This is a very rare early Fidelipac 440 format tape, pre-dating the more common 8-track cartridges. A true collectible for Bobby Vinton fans, tape collectors, or anyone interested in unique audio formats from the 1960s/70s.
Details:
Artist: Bobby Vinton
Album: I Love How You Love Me
Format: 4-Track Stereo Tape Cartridge (Fidelipac 440)
Label: Epic Records
Catalog #: N14 10152
Programs include:
Why Don’t You Believe Me, If I Didn’t Care, Halfway to Paradise, Till, Together, Shangri-La
I Love How You Love Me, It’s No Sin, Save the Last Dance for Me, Those Were the Days, For Once in My Life
Condition:
Cartridge casing shows age, scuffs, and some discoloration (see photos).
Front label has wear, creasing, and surface marks.
Back paper program label has staining and edge wear.
Untested — sold as-is, for collectibility/display only.
Notes:
This is a rare 4-track tape, much harder to find than 8-tracks, and particularly scarce in this bright yellow Fidelipac casing. Great addition to any vintage tape or Bobby Vinton collection.
